stage: 4L12 Retail device calls and contiguous CPU mip storage
changes: GetInfo retail status without modifying output; UNKNOWN format output preservation, format-query validation and API8 D32 depth-match refusal.
MultiplyTransform uses pMatrix times live State and bypasses stateblock recording; SetTransform retains recording behavior.
API8 UP clears live BaseVertexIndex after successful nonempty drawing, without recording; zero primitives preserve it. Missing-stream indexed drawing is a no-op.
API8 creation and lock permissions distinguish usage/pool; uncompressed scratch volumes can bind and release GPU storage, compressed scratch volumes remain CPU-only.
CPU pool 2D/cube mip chains use one checked allocation, face-major with 16-byte face boundaries; destruction never frees interior pointers. Destroyed-window Present refuses before submission.
